description:
I'm Gus Hollis. I fixed pipes and furnaces for forty-one winters up in Vermont's Northeast Kingdom, and I'm retired now. Neighbors still call me at two in the morning, so I figured I'd put what I know where everybody can find it.

On this channel: how to keep your pipes from freezing, your heat from costing a fortune, your alarms working, and repairmen from taking you for a ride. Most of it you can do yourself for a few dollars. When a job needs a licensed pro, I'll tell you that too.

Keep the cold out and the water moving.

Host is an AI-generated character. Stories are dramatized for storytelling; the tips and figures are sourced.
